injuries.name: Nolan Traore
injuries.detail: Traore will be re-evaluated in approximately 8-10 weeks due to a right hamstring strain, Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com reports.

injuries.name: Yaxel Lendeborg
injuries.detail: Lendeborg is questionable for Wednesday's game against the Kings with an illness.

injuries.name: Jimmy Butler III
injuries.detail: Butler (knee) could return sometime between January and February as he continues recovering from a torn right ACL, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Moses Moody
injuries.detail: Moody (knee) is progressing toward a potential return between December and January after rupturing his left patellar tendon in March, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Stephen Curry
injuries.detail: Curry has been diagnosed with an oblique abdominal tear and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Kristaps Porzingis
injuries.detail: Porzingis announced on his social media that he's stepping away from basketball.

injuries.name: Brandon Williams
injuries.detail: Head coach Steve Kerr said Tuesday that Williams (hamstring) is questionable to play Wednesday against the Kings, per Dalton Johnson of NBC Sports Bay Area.

injuries.name: Cameron Boozer
injuries.detail: Boozer (ankle) will be re-evaluated in four weeks, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

injuries.name: Jerami Grant
injuries.detail: Grant was diagnosed with a grade 1 left calf strain and will be re-evaluated in two weeks.

injuries.name: Scotty Pippen Jr.
injuries.detail: Pippen (back) is out for Wednesday's game against the Clippers.

injuries.name: GG Jackson
injuries.detail: Jackson underwent a procedure Wednesday to repair a broken fifth metatarsal in his left foot. He is expected to recover fully and will be re-evaluated in approximately three months.

injuries.name: Richie Saunders
injuries.detail: Saunders signed a two-way contract with the Grizzlies on Saturday, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Mark Williams
injuries.detail: Williams underwent surgery Thursday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will miss an extended period of time, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Ja Morant

injuries.name: Shaedon Sharpe
injuries.detail: Sharpe suffered a torn meniscus in his knee and is expected to miss six months, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

injuries.name: Vit Krejci
injuries.detail: Krejci underwent surgery on his fractured left ankle Wednesday and will be re-evaluated in eight weeks, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

injuries.name: Chris Youngblood
injuries.detail: Youngblood (heel) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Knicks.

injuries.name: Tobias Harris
injuries.detail: Harris (calf) is likely to be sidelined until early December, per Jeff Garcia of KENS 5 San Antonio.

injuries.name: Victor Wembanyama
injuries.detail: Wembanyama (back) is questionable for Wednesday's game in Portland.

injuries.name: Dylan Harper
injuries.detail: Harper (hip) is expected to miss two to three weeks, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

injuries.name: De'Aaron Fox
injuries.detail: Fox (shin) is questionable to play Wednesday's game against the Trail Blazers.

injuries.name: Jayden Quaintance
injuries.detail: Quaintance has been around the team but has not yet been cleared for basketball activities, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.

injuries.name: Maxime Raynaud
injuries.detail: Raynaud (knee) was recalled from the G League's Stockton Kings on Wednesday, Marc J. Spears of ESPN.com reports.

injuries.name: Zach LaVine
injuries.detail: LaVine (knee) is listed as out for Wednesday's game versus the Warriors.

injuries.name: Ben Simmons
injuries.detail: Simmons underwent successful surgery Tuesday to repair a torn right Achilles tendon, James Ham of ESPN 1320 Sacramento reports.
